name: jq-report
title: jq report
blurb: jq report: JSON access-log reports as plain jq programs, a shell command with a tested exit-code contract, and a dependency-free harness that pins every answer

verify.name: usage-error
verify.cmd:
set +e
./bin/{{ npm_name }} --bogus >/dev/null 2>&1
status=$?
echo "exit status: $status"
test "$status" -eq 2

verify.name: missing-file
verify.cmd:
set +e
./bin/{{ npm_name }} run status-counts /nonexistent/log.json >/dev/null 2>&1
status=$?
echo "exit status: $status"
test "$status" -eq 1
